-$('importRecovery').addEventListener('click',async()=>{try{const password=$('recoveryPassword').value;if(password.length<10)throw new Error('กรุณากรอก Recovery Password ของไฟล์ Backup');const r=await window.customerLicenseApi.importRecovery({password});if(!r.canceled){msg(`กู้ License Host สำเร็จ · ${r.pools} entitlement pool(s)`,true);const h=await window.customerLicenseApi.hostInfo();$('hostId').textContent=h.hostId;$('hostFingerprint').textContent=`Fingerprint ${h.fingerprint.slice(0,16)}…`;await refresh();}}catch(e){msg(e.message);}});
+'use strict';
+const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
+const esc=v=>String(v??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
+function msg(t,ok=false){$('message').textContent=t;$('message').className='message'+(ok?' success':'');}
+async function refresh(){const pools=await window.customerLicenseApi.list();$('entitlementId').innerHTML=pools.map(p=>`<option value="${p.entitlementId}">${esc(p.customerName)} · ${esc(p.editionName)} · ${p.used}/${p.seats}</option>`).join('');$('pools').innerHTML=pools.length?pools.map(p=>`<article class="pool"><div><b>${esc(p.productDisplayName)}</b><span>${esc(p.customerName)} · ${esc(p.entitlementLabel)}</span></div><strong>${p.used}/${p.seats}</strong><small>${p.validFrom} → ${p.validUntil} · ${p.available} available</small></article>`).join(''):'<p class="help">No entitlements</p>';}
+(async()=>{const [h,i]=await Promise.all([window.customerLicenseApi.hostInfo(),window.customerLicenseApi.appInfo()]);$('hostId').textContent=h.hostId;$('hostFingerprint').textContent=`Fingerprint ${h.fingerprint.slice(0,16)}…`;$('version').textContent=`Customer License Tool v${i.suiteVersion} · Engine ${i.engineVersion}`;await refresh();})();
+$('copyEnrollment').addEventListener('click',async()=>{await window.customerLicenseApi.copyEnrollment();msg('Enrollment Code copied.',true);});
+$('importEntitlement').addEventListener('click',async()=>{try{const r=await window.customerLicenseApi.importEntitlement();if(!r.canceled){msg('Entitlement imported.',true);await refresh();}}catch(e){msg(e.message);}});
+$('issue').addEventListener('click',async()=>{try{const r=await window.customerLicenseApi.issue({entitlementId:$('entitlementId').value,machineId:$('machineId').value.trim(),computerLabel:$('computerLabel').value.trim()});if(!r.canceled){msg(`License generated · Seat ${r.seatNumber}/${r.seats} · ${r.productDisplayName}`,true);await refresh();}}catch(e){msg(e.message);}});
+$('exportRecovery').addEventListener('click',async()=>{try{const password=$('recoveryPassword').value;if(password.length<10)throw new Error('Recovery Password must be at least 10 characters.');const r=await window.customerLicenseApi.exportRecovery({password});if(!r.canceled)msg('Recovery backup saved.',true);}catch(e){msg(e.message);}});
+$('importRecovery').addEventListener('click',async()=>{try{const password=$('recoveryPassword').value;if(password.length<10)throw new Error('Enter the Recovery Password.');const r=await window.customerLicenseApi.importRecovery({password});if(!r.canceled){msg('License Host restored.',true);const h=await window.customerLicenseApi.hostInfo();$('hostId').textContent=h.hostId;$('hostFingerprint').textContent=`Fingerprint ${h.fingerprint.slice(0,16)}…`;await refresh();}}catch(e){msg(e.message);}});
